mapper.insert: INSERT INTO my_course_appointment (stu_id, c_id, appointment_time, status, remark, create_time) VALUES (#{stuId}, #{cId}, NOW(), #{status}, #{remark}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE my_course SET current_person = current_person + 1 WHERE c_id = #{cId}
UPDATE my_course SET current_person = GREATEST(current_person - 1, 0) WHERE c_id = #{cId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_course_appointment WHERE stu_id = #{stuId} AND c_id = #{cId} AND status IN (0, 1)
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM my_course WHERE c_id = #{cId} AND current_person >= max_person
mapper.update: UPDATE my_course_appointment SET status = 2, update_time = NOW() WHERE ca_id = #{caId}
mapper.select: SELECT ca_id, c_id FROM my_course_appointment WHERE status = 0 AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)
